title: SQL 分析查询模式 (Analytics Patterns)
description: SQL 工作流系列 (14/16)：EXISTS vs IN、JOIN 替代子查询、透视表、覆盖索引、前缀索引与慢查询分析

content.tips: EXISTS 判断存在(推荐大表)
content.content: SELECT * FROM users u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id AND o.status = 'paid');
SELECT * FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM vip_list);
SELECT DISTINCT u.* FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.status = 'paid';
SELECT user_id, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS paid, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'refund' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS refund FROM orders GROUP BY user_id;
SELECT product_id, SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(created_at) = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS jan, SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(created_at) = 2 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS feb FROM orders GROUP BY product_id;
SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE status = 'active';
CREATE INDEX idx_cover ON orders(user_id, status, amount);
SELECT * FROM orders FORCE INDEX (idx_user_id) WHERE user_id = 100;
EXPLAIN SELECT u.name FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.status = 'paid';
